paths.title: From evidence to teachable living systems
paths.audience: A human arriving after the current Workshop builders who needs a reasoned first route through its knowledge.
paths.summary: Begin by preserving evidence, learn to read variation, turn examples into reusable organs, govern visual power, inspect how an Academy declares its teaching contract, then apply honest boundaries to a living-system model.
paths.boundary: This is a suggested first route, not a mandatory curriculum, proof of mastery, publication decision or source of authority. A learner may inspect, skip, repeat or leave it at any time.
outcomes: Separate source observations from interpretations and canon claims.
Explain how examples become bounded, reusable organs with inspectable receipts.
Read a module contract as a map of capabilities, handoffs, extension seams and explicit refusals.
Apply explicit non-claim boundaries when reasoning about a complex model.

stages.reason: Learn how observations, contradictions and rejected variants survive before interpreting what the Workshop made.
Practise reading real visual variation while keeping integrity receipts separate from personal suitability.
Move from examples to reusable structures, bounded moods and explicit performance profiles.
Study how a powerful presentation organ stays reversible and refuses hidden behavioral authority.
Read the Academy's own module contract so future builders can see how teaching capabilities, handoffs, extension slots and refusals stay explicit.
Transfer the method into a complex living-world model where supported claims and explicit non-claims coexist.
